name: Cursing
overview: Scripture condemns the misuse of God's name and the act of cursing, emphasizing the serious consequences for those who take His name in vain as stated in Exodus 20:7. The account of Shimei cursing King David vividly illustrates the destructive nature of cursing, linking it to accusations of bloodshed and moral corruption (2 Samuel 16:5-8). Additionally, Psalms 109:17 portrays cursing as a chosen path that brings judgment upon the one who delights in it, contrasting it with the blessing that believers are called to pursue. Together, these passages underscore the biblical call to honor God and others through speech, refraining from curses that invite divine judgment.
